verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to operate Sentry itself through natural-language commands. The agent-tracing material (conversation replay, LLM call views) covers monitoring other people's AI agents, not driving Sentry. Seer is described only as a debugging agent that finds root causes and generates patches. The 'your agent will set up Sentry' item relies on external coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code, which is a user-side workaround rather than a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
